# pve_file_oci_pull (Action)

Pull an OCI image artifact into a storage template volume.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_file_oci_pull" "example" {
  config {
    node      = "pve1"
    reference = "CHANGE_ME"
    storage   = "local"
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_file_oci_pull.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `reference` (String) The reference to the OCI image to download.
- `storage` (String) The storage identifier.

### Optional

- `filename` (String) Custom destination file name of the OCI image. Caution: This will be normalized!
